name: Makino Anri
source:
She is a third-year student at a private integrated school in the same city as the main character. 

She attends a school so well-known that even the protagonist can recognize her by her uniform.

[From [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/wendybell/tukikano/char07.html]official site[/url]]
